notes.title: Lost Rift Demo Is Live!
notes.content:
Play the Lost Rift Demo for FREE September 17-24! This is your chance to get a taste of the core gameplay loop before the full game launches on September 25, 2025.

[previewyoutube="7Sq0dV-Sb-Y;full"][/previewyoutube]


In the demo, you'll start your journey on Pioneers’ Landing, where you'll be introduced to Wade, a character who will help you get established and guide you toward your first Expedition on Western Island. This is where you'll experience the intense extraction shooter gameplay that's at the heart of Lost Rift.

Back on Pioneers’ Landing, you’ll see the ever-present anomaly wall, which will restrict your access to the starting area for the duration of the demo. The wall will finally come down on launch day, September 25.  

Please read on below to see all of the new features and significant changes that we’ve made to the demo since our last public playtest.

Demo Notice: Any progress you make during the demo, including your character and island progress, will not transfer to the launch version of the game. All data will be wiped before the official launch.

Let us know what you think on our social channels, and be sure to add us to your Steam Wishlist.


No Host Needed: Shared Islands
We've made it easier than ever to play together. You and your squadmates can now access any Shared Island at any time, without needing the player who created the island to be online. Any player with access can launch the island whenever they want. The person who initially creates the Shared Island can send a more secure one-time invite code to each friend, which provides access to the island. Our new invite codes also help prevent unwanted guests from showing up and causing trouble.

Visually Updated Building System
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/73a20cedf6e6cfc8082f0a75d6a9ec936ef8a86d.jpg"]

The building in Lost Rift has undergone significant visual upgrades since our last playtest. The thatch building set has been completely visually overhauled and now includes the following pieces:  

Thatch Floor Tile (5x, 3x, 1x)

Thatch Triangle Floor Tile (5x, 3x, 1x)

Thatch Wall Tile (5x, 3x, 1x)

Thatch Wall Triangle (5x, 3x, 1x)

Thatch Inverted Wall Triangle (5x, 3x, 1x)

Thatch Angled Roof (5x, 3x, 1x)

Thatch Angled Tile (5x, 3x, 1x)

Wood Vertical Beam (5x, 3x, 1x)

Wood Horizontal Beam (5x, 3x, 1x)

Wood Diagonal Beam (5x, 3x, 1x)

Thatch Door

We look forward to seeing what players can create with all of these options.

Many of the functional and decorative items that can be placed in your base camp have also received visual updates. We will leave these for you to explore!
Get Comfy!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/41d60777723d93191585085dea4c8fc66c2a312f.jpg"]

Tired of a boring, lifeless base? Now you can jazz it up with some decorations and get a bonus while you're at it! Decorating your base camp with furniture and other fun items now gives you a Comfort Buff. The more you decorate, the stronger the buff gets.

Check your Camp Comfort Level at the Survivor Beacon

Each decoration gives you comfort points (1-10 points per item)

Some items, like plants, can be placed multiple times for more points (up to 5 of the same type)

Other items, like a bed, only give you points for the first one you place

Your goal is to reach a Camp Comfort Rank of 10 by getting 1000 points. At this max rank, you'll get a big bonus: a +50 stamina buff that lasts for 20 minutes and is refreshed by sleeping at the camp. Your Comfort Buff will also persist when travelling to Expedition, to get the edge over your opponents!


Progression Updates
If you have played in multiple playtests, you’ll know that early-game progression is something we have been hammering away on to perfect it. We have been focused on helping new players become more established at camp and better prepared for the battles ahead on Expedition. 


Many changes have been made to streamline the gameplay flow, including adjustments to the amount of resources picked up and harvested, crafting recipe requirements, and the process of unlocking different recipes. 

Visual Upgrades
Lost Rift continues to look better than ever as new game art floods the islands. You’ll notice visual changes to foliage, upgrades to POIs on the Western Island, as well as art updates to consumables, decorative items, workbenches, and more. 


No Infinite Revives: Heavy Wound System
When you are downed, you will now receive a debuff called Heavy Wound. This debuff will start a timer during which you will not be able to be revived again. The debuff will prevent squads from repeatedly reviving each other during active PVP altercations. 


Expedition Rejoin
If you get disconnected from an Expedition due to a server error or a crash, you'll now be able to rejoin your previous mission right away from the main menu. This means your progress, loot, and inventory will be safe. You can jump right back into the action without losing anything!


Enemy AI Improvements
We've been hard at work polishing the enemy AI and combat, making every encounter more challenging and fun. This includes everyone's favorite enemy, Bonkey. We've also made a significant change to how enemies spawn. Now, the number of enemies you face will scale to the number of players in your squad. Whether you're playing solo or with a full squad, you'll encounter a fair but challenging number of hyenas and Outcasts on your Island and during Expeditions.


Finally, we've fixed many navigation bugs that were causing enemies to act dumber than intended. They'll now move more intelligently, so be prepared!


Additional Changes
You can now spectate your teammates on Expedition upon your death.

We are now enforcing a character limit and an Island limit. Each player can create up to three characters and three islands. However, there is no limit on how many of your friends' islands you can join.

We’ve added Transfer Item Stacks and Loot All buttons in the inventory screen, allowing you to optimize your backpack and empty loot faster into chests after Expeditions. 

Improved gamepad support, especially in Big Picture mode

Dodos now eat berries!
If you enjoy the demo, be sure to wishlist us on Steam and come back on September 25 for the Early Access release!

notes.title: Anomaly Log Update #004 - Dr. Emilia Gates
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/f2b15a990bfaf8c0a4833c94621a006c279c13e3.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/ac2f263a696ecf294610e068054e16e7b64a63a9.jpg"]

ANOMALY LOG UPDATE
Dr. Emilia Gates, Operation Victoria
SUBJECT:	Anomaly Log Post-Incident Analysis - Historical Maritime Wreck “Ranger” (Reference: Event VIC-0531)

For as long as OpVic has been established, the remnants of an aged wooden sailing vessel have sat half-buried along the tidal flats west of Sector Bravo-8. We assumed it to be the wreckage of a colonial merchant craft, too degraded to justify extensive analysis at the time with many other rift anomalies present.

However, after extensive cross-referencing of rigging layouts and historical registries, we are now able to speculate the vessel’s likely identity: the Ranger, a sloop captained by infamous pirate John “Calico Jack” Rackham. The ship was believed to have been destroyed by British forces in 1720, with no known remnants ever recovered. Unbeknownst to the world, it appears that the Ranger has been here, resting undisturbed and embedded in the sand.

It is difficult to speculate on the conditions under which it entered the rift. Despite the erosion, a few core structural elements remain intact: cannon ports, deck rail, and several fixtures bearing early 1700s craftsmanship. But the vessel's apparent lack of collision or fire damage suggests it may have entered this universe through a low-energy rift and washed ashore centuries ago (by local measure).

As the Ranger predates our presence on this island, it stands to reason that other objects, perhaps even older than this ship, may lie hidden or misidentified throughout the archipelago. A historical reevaluation of other shoreline wreckage sites is now underway.

Dr. Emilia Gates

notes.title: Anomaly Log Update #003 - Dr. Emilia Gates
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/f2b15a990bfaf8c0a4833c94621a006c279c13e3.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/9f98f393878764686e8c9e308d931a22b03671a7.jpg"]

ANOMALY LOG UPDATEDr. Emilia Gates, Operation VictoriaSUBJECT: Anomaly Log Post-Incident Analysis – Civilian Maritime Disappearance (Reference: Event VIC-0467

At 18:32 local time, watch personnel at the Southern Victoria Outpost on Western Island reported the sudden appearance of a beached vessel along the shoreline. The wreck had not been present even an hour earlier, yet the vessel’s condition suggests prolonged environmental exposure.

Visual assessment identified the boat as a 23-foot cabin cruiser. Though heavily eroded, the registration number was confirmed via side panel etching and matched to the Witchcraft, a yacht reported missing off the coast of Miami in 1967. According to Universe Mundus records, the vessel vanished only one mile offshore after issuing a non-emergency distress call.

Here in Victoria, the Witchcraft has manifested fully deteriorated, lodged in the sand within direct line of sight of our outpost. Its presence was abrupt as if it phase-shifted into position mid-tide. Despite clear signs of long-term degradation, there are no indicators of impact-related damage.

If Witchcraft did breach the Rift and appear now, aged and weathered, it reinforces our working theory: Victoria receives displaced matter along an asynchronous timeline. The past in Universe Mundus can emerge in our present, long after or even before the event itself.

I have recorded coordinates and submitted photographic documentation for archival cross-reference. Given the vessel’s sudden appearance and its proximity to our perimeter, this may be the first known instance of Rift activity occurring in direct view.

Dr. Emilia Gates

notes.title: Anomaly Log Update #002 - Dr. Emilia Gates
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/f2b15a990bfaf8c0a4833c94621a006c279c13e3.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/e7d6a7f705d1250a922e4e0c9c8bab2779a2f49f.jpg

ANOMALY LOG UPDATE
Dr. Emilia Gates, Operation Victoria
Subject: Post-incident analysis - U.S. Naval Aviation Event “Flight 19” (Reference: Event VIC-0191)

This morning, I received a dispatch from OpVic Headquarters in Universe Mundus. A multiversal anomaly was detected: five aircraft, a U.S. Navy training squadron, vanished into a high-altitude Rift above the Atlantic. HQ flagged the event, Flight 19, as active and advised my team to prepare for a possible incursion.

However, here in Victoria, the story has already come to an end. I instructed ground teams to re-check a known crash site in Sector Charlie-7, where we had previously catalogued an aviation wreckage. A second pass with updated reference material confirmed it: the wreck is remnants of Flight 19.

The fuselage is fragmented and deeply oxidized, but the tail numbers match precisely. We recovered some human remains, those of a pilot who had attempted to make camp in a nearby cave. The other four aircraft remain lost to us, and perhaps still lost in time and space as well.
This discovery confirms a troubling conclusion: time does not flow consistently between our worlds. 

While Flight 19 is only now being reported as active in Universe Mundus, they have already crashed and perished here in Universe Sinum. This is not the first time we've noted desynchronization between timelines, but the clarity of this case is unsettling. 

Whenever I am able to send communications back across the rift, the Flight 19 incident must be reclassified from active recovery to historical closure. I will record the coordinates and remains for archival purposes.

Dr. Emilia Gates

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/56fcb020f84e08e9be8f6b0b1acc9c23194297cf.png

notes.title: Anomaly Log Update #001 - Dr. Emilia Gates
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/f2b15a990bfaf8c0a4833c94621a006c279c13e3.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/dc69ceb11c4815ac9c3a81cf27a59c60b428e33e.jpg

ANOMALY LOG UPDATE
Dr. Emilia Gates, Operation Victoria
Subject: Post-incident analysis - Soviet Naval Encounter (Reference: Event VIC-0327)

At 04:17 GMT, dimensional sensors registered a sudden rift ripple in Quadrant 4-C, followed by extreme pressure displacement and a brief but intense electromagnetic flare consistent with interdimensional stress. Preliminary acoustic readings suggested the rupture of non-native steel under pressure. Within 14 seconds of the breach, a Soviet Foxtrot-class submarine appeared with hull markings confirming identity as B-59.

The vessel manifested with visible hull deformation and severe oxidation, inconsistent with its expected condition if preserved in our timeline. Full biological scans were inconclusive; no life signs were found. However, movement was noted within the control room for approximately 43 seconds post-arrival. 

Most notably, the vessel’s fifteen-kiloton nuclear warhead is still intact and is undergoing stabilization protocols. The presence of a functional nuclear warhead raises serious ethical and procedural concerns. This event predates our operational timeline and may require diplomatic oversight if data is leaked. 

The warhead's radiation signature is currently stable, but anomalously “phased” and drifting slightly out of sync with baseline quantum decay. More pressingly, it confirms that nuclear materials are not neutralized by Rift passage. This phenomenon may provide insight into how time behaves under Rift displacement. The implication is staggering: radioactive material aging at a different rate than its environment.

Dr. Emilia Gates

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/1599f624dd9fe9aa2fc01f963a542a0b70333ba5.png

notes.title: Lost Rift Coming to Early Access September 25!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ElGXodS-Y6k;full][/previewyoutube]
Get ready to wash ashore on the mysterious archipelago of Lost Rift. Lost Rift will be launching into Steam Early Access on September 25, 2025 for $24.99 USD, with a limited-time 20% launch discount!

Lost Rift is a first-person survival shooter combining base-building, cooperative PvE, and intense PvPvE gameplay. Set in a mysterious archipelago, players wash up on the island of Pioneers’ Landing to begin their journey to survive, explore, conquer, and progress.

The Early Access experience features new and exciting major game updates, including: 

10+ Hours of New PvE Narrative Gameplay
Venture beyond the safety of the shores into narrative quests, enemies, and secrets to uncover as you explore the island with your friends. With several unique survivors to recruit, your quest will uncover the mysteries behind each new area.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/0a17a092aec3a703c8d57732d7224c7c71e1961b.jpg
Solo & Co-Op PvE Survival
Brave the archipelago solo or team up with up to four friends. Gather resources, craft weapons and armor, and take on hostile PvE enemies across dangerous landscapes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/c5e69cf569d4763696591145aac76a2541ea8b3e.png
PvPvE Multiplayer Combat Expeditionss
Risk it all in multiplayer combat expeditions. Rally your team to secure rare loot and extract alive, or lose it all to rival players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/ef56c52581bd09e5507b6ddc13aad768467883df.jpg
Survival Sandbox & Base Building
Utilize a unique tile-based shelter building system to craft, repair, and upgrade your ultimate base camp. Build the perfect hideout to keep your squad alive and prepare for what’s ahead.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/e56ef3e9fef45c28601aeadf85de6348e6177558.jpg
A World to Explore
From dense jungles and sunny beaches to forgotten outposts and storm-lashed stations, each biome offers unique challenges, rewards, and threats. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/aa452df8781c6caaec8ea22c69f73480d2c763e1.jpg
A Note on Early Access
The focus at launch is on delivering the core survival experience. Some final art and polish (such as greybox placeholders) will be updated in future milestones as we expand and evolve the game with the community’s feedback.

We’re incredibly grateful for the support we've received from the community, and we can’t wait to share all the major content updates we have planned once the game goes live! Please stay tuned for our Public Roadmap, which we will be sharing closer to launch time.

notes.title: Playtest Ended & Meet Dr. Fynn Sullivan!
notes.content:
Our playtest is now offline!

Thank you to everyone who played during this stress test. The Lost Rift team remains deep in development as we push toward our Early Access launch. Your feedback from playtests has been invaluable, and we are already discussing how to incorporate your feedback in as much as possible. We’ve read your comments, followed your discussions, and yes… we know there are still bugs to squash.

Early Access is a partnership between our team and our players to shape Lost Rift into the best game it can be. By inviting you in before the full release, we have been able to gather real-world feedback, see how you engage with our systems, and identify what works and what doesn’t long before the final version. A stress test, like our most recent test, allows us to test our servers and make sure everything runs as smoothly as possible on many types of hardware. This collaborative approach also allows us to refine balance, squash bugs, and introduce features based directly on your feedback. 

If you played in the playtest over the weekend, we’d love for you to take a short feedback survey. Feel free to include as much (or as little) info as you'd like to share with us.

Please click here to complete the survey.

Dr. Fynn Sullivan: The Cavebound Scientist

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/78c1367f1fb24f1e321bfdb28fff6a8b873982ae.jpg

For the last thirty years, Dr. Fynn Sullivan has lived isolated in a fortified cave on the same island of Victoria that you’ve washed up on. On his mind is a single obsession: to unlock the secrets of Kennedite, a material located on the island that he believes can open a path back home. 

Fynn was once a leading researcher for Operation Victoria, the scientific organization present on the island. However, Fynn’s caution in studying Kennedite put him in direct conflict with the military’s impatient leader, Captain Wade Davis. Their rivalry exploded, quite literally, when his actions caused a deadly blast that severely injured Wade and many others. 

Racked with guilt but vowing to continue his research, he disappeared. Understandably, Wade has despised him ever since. Now in his sixties, he’s worn down from years hunched over improvised workbenches, with a wild-eyed stare that hints at both brilliance and the toll of isolation. Fatigued but sharp, his mind never stops working. 

When you find Fynn, he will not leave the safety of his cave base. He has managed to stay alive with the help of other survivors on the island, and now you are among them. Too wary of the dangers outside, he will enlist you as his hands and eyes. Exactly what he is working toward by asking you to help with his research, and how far he is willing to go, is something you will have to discover for yourself.

Helping Fynn will bring you closer to understanding Kennedite’s true power and deeper into his decades-long mission of escape, but it also risks opening doors that should remain shut.

notes.title: Join the Lost Rift Playtest Today!
notes.content:
We are live with our next public stress test for Lost Rift, and we need your help! Jump in to explore our latest updates, push our systems to their limits, and help us shape the future of the game as we head towards Early Access.

STRESS TEST DATES
 August 7 at 1:30pm EDT until August 11 at 10am EDT
 Free and open to all via a 'Join the Playtest' button on our Steam Page; no sign-up or keys required!

ACCESS
In your Steam store, head over to our Steam page and click on the 'Join the Playtest' button in order to get access.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/27d2736fed6e680e09e4f9e45fd461f41a74d1b2.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3494520/Lost_Rift/
PLAY TO UNLOCK NEW LORE
Participating in this test will unlock the backstory of a mysterious new character… Get ready to meet Wade’s nemesis: [REDACTED].

As a challenge for our community, once we hit over 1000 Expedition Extractions, we will unlock [REDACTED]’s biography. You’ll unlock their name, their backstory, and how you’ll interact with them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/7163c5b0b3a26bb4197a0388a05b69b86dc47462.jpg

WHAT’S PLAYABLE IN THIS TEST
You'll have access to a focused slice of our early game on Pioneers’ Landing (PvE) and all of Western Island Expedition (PvPvE) to explore. Exploration beyond the anomaly wall on Pioneers’ Landing is restricted while we continue tuning the game’s core progression. 

KEY FEATURES AND IMPROVEMENTS
Thanks to all your feedback on our previous playtests and demo, we have made some serious progress across the board. Here's what changes are waiting for you.

Matchmaking
 Matchmaking now better matches players within their same regions (this is loosened if the wait for a match takes too long)
 Improved matchmaking logic for PvP servers to be created in the most optimal region for all of the players in the match
 PvP matches now group players more fairly based on party size
Environment Art

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/eb63fdeabeb9ab8d56c360dfa8ae2dc8efa35c51.jpg
 Significant visual improvements across maps
 Updated Points of Interest on Western Island Expedition: Weather Station, Harbor, and Lighthouse
Building

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/35d94ba29a66eccc0b6a3365e4b3f2ea53882c37.jpg
 New diagonal pillars, triangle walls, and triangle floor pieces
User Experience

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/6abb9f9b726ab228c9006675b5b3b8f2010924a3.gif
 Expanded character creator options, including new hairstyles, body types, and clothing
 Improved onboarding for new players
Combat
 Improved gunplay and overall balance
 Enhanced AI behavior for Hyenas and Outcasts
 Your base now has a chance to be raided by hyenas and Outcasts. Defeat the hostile invaders and complete the associated Side Quest (Hyena Problem or Jungle Outcasts, hit J to open your Journal)
Progression

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/e5bcdfa6ea0b77fc4d6ba94fc207dac257e4ebf2.jpg
 Reworked side quests from Wade with new objectives and rewards
 Updated Expedition UI and Journal interface for clearer mission flow and quest tracking
Localization

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/1b66554354b5005b1014bbabbbe629442b4cea2c.jpg
 Machine-translated localization available for all supported languages
 Please note: translation inaccuracies may be present
 Official translations are planned for Early Access launch
Bug Fixes & Stability
 Multiple crash fixes
 Ongoing bug resolution across systems

KNOWN ISSUES FOR THIS PLAYTEST
Please see this forum post on the Discussions page for a list of Known Issues.

TELL US WHAT YOU THINK!
Our community is our compass guiding this expedition. Throughout this playtest, we will be active and listening to your feedback on all our social channels. Join the conversation and let us know what’s working, what isn’t, and what you want to see next.

Every test makes Lost Rift stronger, and we can’t do it without you. We appreciate you fitting this playtest into your busy schedules.

notes.title: Lost Rift Stress Playtest August 7!
notes.content:
Rifters, your next opportunity to play Lost Rift is this week!

The final countdown has begun. This Thursday August 7, at 10am EDT, we’re hosting our next public stress playtest!

We’ve made changes and improvements across the board since you last saw us. We’re excited to have you back in the game to see what we’ve been working on behind the scenes. Heads up, this playtest will not cover all of the new features we’ve been making progress on, but rather focus on refining our key systems and ensuring both server performance and stability. Read on to hear about what you can expect from this test!


UPGRADES & IMPROVEMENTS
 More Character Creator options[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/6abb9f9b726ab228c9006675b5b3b8f2010924a3.gif"] Fairer PvP matchmaking, especially for solo and duo players
 Updated AI for hyenas and Outcasts
 Crash fixes to improve stability (with more to come)
 Machine-translated localization (official translations coming for Early Access)
 Updated Expedition UI for clearer mission flow
 New Journal interface to better track your quest objectives[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/e5bcdfa6ea0b77fc4d6ba94fc207dac257e4ebf2.jpg"] Reworked side quests from Wade with new objectives and rewards
 Improved gunplay and balance
 Bug fixes: many squashed, more being hunted as we speak


EXPLORE UPDATES POINTS OF INTEREST
Grey boxes are being smashed left, right, and center! 

Explore new sights to see and new dangers to brave on Expedition: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/5a1c3cd03db33a5a19a892888f90ea4099136e09.gif"] 

Jump in this Thursday to see our third updated POI! Whether you're looting alone or surviving with friends, these updated and polished locations will bring more tactical depth and lore to uncover. The total playable area you’ll have access to will remain the same, featuring Pioneers’ Landing (PvE) and Expedition (PvPvE), as well as the same mysterious boundary that limits progression beyond the anomaly’s edge. The wall has been placed to help us hone in on the early-game experience. 

 
PARTICIPATE IN THE STRESS TEST
August 7 at 10am EDT until August 11 at 10am EDT. 

Free and open to all via a 'Join the Playtest' button on our Steam Page; no sign-up or keys required!


SHARE YOUR FEEDBACK
We’re building Lost Rift with the help of our community, and your voice directly shapes its evolution. We are listening to your feedback across all our social channels, including:
 Steam forums & reviews
 Discord (#feedback-for-devs and #bug-reports channels)
 Reddit: r/LostRiftGame
 Twitch & YouTube contentFollow and wishlist Lost Rift on Steam to get notified when Early Access arrives.

notes.title: Play Lost Rift Stress Test August 7th!
notes.content:
Rifters, your next opportunity to play Lost Rift is only two weeks away!

On August 7 at 10am EDT, we’ll be live with our next public stress playtest. Whether you're a returning castaway or if this will be your first playing Lost Rift, this is your chance to jump in and help us shape the game’s future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/ad2998727e33997860131007ae02d736241ff2c5.gif
Playable Zone: Weather Station (on Expedition)

WHAT WE’VE ADDRESSED FROM YOUR FEEDBACK
 Better onboarding experience for new players (no more confusion over Tree Sap or Volcanic Rock)
 More fair PVP matchmaking for solo and duos
 Better balance for AI enemies
 Multiple crash fixes (though some may remain)
 Basic localization support added
WHAT’S IN THIS STRESS TEST
This playtest is focused on server stress-testing and system improvements, including:
 Environment Art Progress: far fewer grey boxes and some truly stunning environment upgrades will be present, including the Weather Station (see gif)
 Matchmaking Upgrades: PVP Expedition will now group players more fairly based on party size
 Core System Updates: improved gunplay and overall balance
 Side Quest Improvements: reworked side quests given by Wade, to give players access to new and cool objectives
 Machine-translated Language Support: we are still working with a localization partner to have official translations for day 1 of Early Access 
 Bug Fixes: and lots of them!]
The playable area you’ll have access to will remain the same, with both Pioneers’ Landing (PvE) and Expedition (PvPvE) being available just as it was in our previous Steam Next Fest demo. You’ll encounter familiar ground and the same mysterious wall that blocks further exploration. This will allow us to refine the early game experience without distractions beyond the anomaly perimeter.

WHEN & HOW
 August 7 at 10am EDT until August 11 at 10am EDT
 Free and open to all via Steam; no sign-up or keys required!

If you’ve already followed and wishlisted us on Steam, you’ll be notified the moment the test goes live!

YOUR FEEDBACK
Your feedback has already helped us make major strides during the development of Lost Rift. Now we need your help again to push Lost Rift even further. 
 Steam forums and reviews
 Discord (#feedback-for-devs and #bug-reports channels)
 Your content on YouTube and Twitch
 Reddit: join our newly launched r/LostRiftGame and share your experiences
Be sure to wishlist Lost Rift on Steam to stay in the loop and get notified when Early Access launches.

We will see you in Pioneers’ Landing very soon!

notes.title: Thanks for playing in our Steam Next Fest Demo!
notes.content:
Hey Rifters,

It’s been one week since our Steam Next Fest alpha demo came to an end. We again want to extend a massive thank you to all our intrepid explorers who jumped into the Lost Rift demo during Next Fest. 

Over 50,000 brave Rifters set foot on Pioneers’ Landing during the demo, fighting their way through outcasts, hyenas, dodos, and other players to complete over 10,000 successful Expeditions. Oh, and we can’t forget Bonkey! Bonkey managed to claim the lives of over 950 very unlucky players. Ouch, we are not responsible for those damages.

Oh yeah, thanks to you all, Lost Rift was also one of the most played demos during Steam Next Fest. Holy smokes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/53db163133901ac75128f8a49a6d92c06a9bab93.jpg

Since the demo was taken offline earlier this week, our entire team has been heads-down in numerous feedback review meetings, combing through absolutely everything you've shared with us through your Stream reviews, Discord messages, YouTube videos, and Twitch streams. We’ve identified several actionable improvements that we’ve already started working on:


 Reviewing early game pacing and progression flow
 Enhancing PvE and solo gameplay viability
 Prioritizing fixes for most reported bugs and crashes
 Addressing enemy AI difficulty based on your encounters
 Improving and expanding building and crafting for smoother play
 Additional language support
 Much more!

We are also currently putting together a public roadmap that outlines more of our long-term development plans, but for now, please know that your voices are being heard and are directly influencing our EA priorities.

Thanks again for being part of this journey with us, and we look forward to having you back in Pioneers’ Landing.

notes.title: Announcing the Lost Rift Steam Playtest
notes.content:
With Lost Rift formally announced and set to launch later this year, it's a good topic to start with: what Early Access means for Lost Rift.

While Early Access is becoming increasingly common in games, the definition of what Early Access is intended to look like varies significantly across different games, platforms, and genres.

We plan to be fully transparent about what we intend to deliver with your purchase of Lost Rift on Day 1, as well as what will be added later in Early Access development.

Why Early Access?

To answer this question as simply as possible, we believe that now is the ideal time to gather community feedback on what we should focus on next. The core gameplay loop has come together well, and there is sufficient content to showcase our vision for the game. 

We believe we’re creating a great game, and we think it can only be improved with your feedback. So, without further delay, below you’ll find exactly what we intend to bring to Early Access, as well as what will be coming in the future. 

What Comes with Early Access?

The base game and access to all future non-DLC updates, initially up to 5 characters, and 5 PvE island instances saved on our dedicated servers, with no limit on how many of your friends’ islands you join.

We plan to deliver both a PvE island (also known as Pioneers’ Landing) where you can spend hours exploring and building your survival space, along with a high-risk, high-reward PvPvE extraction experience where rare and exotic loot can be obtained that will help you progress your quests when you return.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/63f466a6bcb909c117df384aa43c1b3c87e39f6c.jpg

What We Plan to Bring Early Access on Day 1

The Lost Rift team is striving to bring you three key things on Early Access launch day:

1. A Strong Core Gameplay Loop & Body of Content

We’re applying People Can Fly’s expertise in gunplay and fusing PvE survival and PvPvE extraction into a unique, replayable, ever-evolving experience. We want to generate an experience that incites wonder and curiosity as you begin to explore Pioneers' Landing, our PvE-only island. You can explore, build, hunt, cook, and craft alongside with up to four friends, or as a solo adventurer. You can uncover new areas at your own pace, stock up on supplies, complete quests, and recruit NPC Survivors to help protect your base camp. 

In juxtaposition to the relative safety of the PvE survival island, we also plan to have the first fully explorable Expedition island, a time-pressured and intense PvPvE experience filled with stronger PvE threats and, more importantly, rare loot that you can’t craft back at Pioneers' Landing. You may run into other matchmade players, where you will have to decide whether to engage or stick to the shadows and loot the scraps of bigger teams.

You’ll find a variety of enemies on Expeditions, including Outcasts (our name for the humanoid enemies), predators both big and small, prey, other real players, and more as you try to locate the wires, screwdrivers, and other special loot required to progress the initial story. If you die on an Expedition, you’ll lose everything you had with you and return to Pioneers' Landing. If you successfully extract, you’ll retain everything you found and be one step closer to accessing new areas or quests.

We want to demonstrate how we can seamlessly blend these two experiences, all while incorporating satisfying gunplay that delivers strong, moment-to-moment gameplay.

2. Stable Experience
We want to ensure that you have a stable and friction-free experience. Our team has collaborated for months to do everything possible to quickly mitigate any issues with connecting to servers and provide a stable experience, allowing you to focus on giving us gameplay feedback instead of troubleshooting.

While we can’t promise everything will be perfect, this is early access for a reason, after all. We’re becoming increasingly confident, having conducted internal company-wide tests, and will be rolling it out to a much larger scale with Steam Playtest on May 15th.

3. Transparency & Open Communication

We announced in mid-March and launched our Discord server, with most of our development team as active participants, who can be identified by their handles, which start with 'PCF_'. We aim to be transparent about our goals and what we intend to deliver during Early Access, allowing you to see more of the work in progress through quick screengrabs, GIFs, and playtest blooper videos.

Once players get their hands on the game, we will listen to your feedback. Whether you think something is too powerful, too weak, too long, or too short, we genuinely want to know about it, and we believe our team can deliver an even better game with your collaboration and contributions. 

What we won’t have on Day 1 of Early Access

With transparency in mind, all of the below are goals we’ll be working towards over the course of Early Access, but won’t be fully realized on launch day. 

We won’t have the final art & assets
Our small team of artists has been hard at work delivering a wealth of outfits, jungle biomes, weapons, building pieces, and more. That said, the game will be far from ‘art complete’ on Day 1 of Early Access.

This means that you will encounter missing textures, placeholder assets, and greybox in our game. Gameplay is king, and incomplete art should not prevent us from sharing our plans or delaying our playtests, allowing you to play and provide your feedback. 

Here is one easy example of art in our game and what “Placeholder” or “Greybox” means. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/e2778a8c18c988d93141e0ce9287704acfd2dd27.jpg

The above screenshot is a great example. From a distance, you can tell what the Antenna is, and it has a rough shape. However, it lacks textures and artistic refinement to make it look like an actual building. It’s there, it’s functional for gameplay, but it's far from the quality we’re striving for in our 1.0 game launch. Many of our assets are currently in this state, and we have a priority list of improvements for 2025. 

We won’t have a bug-free experience
You can have the biggest and best QA team in the world, and players will find more weird and wonderful issues on day one than the QA team finds in a year.

As a result, we’ve been working diligently to organize ourselves to streamline our reporting and bug-fixing process. We’re ready to listen, diagnose, and patch starting from day one. When you experience an issue, hit us up on Discord or the Lost Rift Steam Forums, and we’ll be sure to pick up the torch (no pun intended) and address it as soon as possible. 

Wrapping Up

We’re incredibly excited to put this game in front of you, starting with our first open Playtest beginning 10 AM Eastern on May 15th, 2025. To be the first to learn how to sign up, join our Discord.

We’re looking forward to you testing our servers and providing feedback to help us build the game alongside you, rather than just behind the scenes. Thank you for reading.

- PCF_Harmonious
Lost Rift Product Owner
